items.title: Deebo Samuel: No practice Wednesday
items.text:
Samuel (hamstring) won't take part in practice Wednesday, Cam Inman of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

items.title: Mike Evans: Won't practice Wednesday
items.text:
Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Evans (Achilles) won't practice Wednesday, NFL reporter Andrew Siciliano reports.

items.title: David Montgomery: Will miss Sunday's game
items.text:
While Montgomery (groin) has made some progress, coach DeMeco Ryans noted Wednesday that the running back will remain out for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown: Limited at Wednesday's walkthrough
items.text:
St. Brown was a limited participant at Wednesday's walkthrough due to a rib injury, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.
